text: Claimant app uses channel 'claimant_web' (Channel enum in common.schema.json), not 'web'; submit sends Idempotency-Key via api.post(path, body, {headers}); upload via api.upload(path, FormData)

Kit api.post/upload lack per-call headers (Idempotency-Key) and FormData upload; claimant app adapts locally. fx-timeline is an event log (.events), so stage list is rendered in-app plus fx-timeline for activity.

Adjuster app: no accept/dismiss endpoint exists for fraud/subrogation items; decisions are stored as POST /claims/{id}/notes with category fraud|subrogation and body prefix '[decision:accepted|dismissed] <note>', plus best-effort PATCH of the open siu_referral/subrogation_review task (in_progress/cancelled). Request a first-class decision endpoint if audit needs structured data.

Admin console at /admin built. No GET /config/versions endpoint exists: history tries it, then GET /audit (tenant.config.updated), then shows a fallback note. Request: add GET /config/versions (version, actor, createdAt).

S2-EXP-03-1 claimant status.js: timers.setTimeout(...) is called on a plain object holding window.setTimeout, throws Illegal invocation in browsers after submit, so status polling never schedules. Fix: bind (timers.setTimeout.bind(globalThis)) or default to arrow wrappers.

S2-EXP-03-2 claimant app.js startSession never sends lossType, so the tenant auto-glass question set (glass_location) is unreachable from the claimant UI; it always gets auto-general. Needs a loss-type choice or inference.

S6-EXP-01 fx-app-shell demo slot contract: put <fx-demo-bar slot="demo"> as a direct child of <fx-app-shell>; the shell moves it into a sticky band above the top bar (light DOM, no shadow root). The shell observes the slotted element's height (ResizeObserver) and sets --fx-demo-height on itself and on documentElement (0px when empty) so sticky offsets stay correct. The demo bar should use tokens --fx-demo-bg/--fx-demo-fg/--fx-demo-border (dark neutral band, defined in tokens.css) and .fx-select/.fx-btn classes; height <= 48px at desktop, may wrap on mobile. Shell attributes: product, title, subtitle, user-name, user-role, tenant-name, nav-label; slots: demo, nav, actions, user-menu (extra items), default = page body. Shell emits fx-signout from the user menu. Shell never imports demo-bar.js.

S6-EXP-02 persona list contract: GET /api/v1/dev/personas (public, devMode only, 404 otherwise) -> {tenants:[{id,name,branding:{primaryColor,accentColor,fontFamily},personas:[{id:"<tenant>:<key>",userId,displayName,role,roles[],app:"/"|"/csr"|"/adjuster"|"/admin",appLabel,path,hint?:{policyNumber,lastName,zip,lob} (claimant only),note?}]}]}. Roles: claimant, csr, agent, adjuster, supervisor, carrier_admin (roles also tenant_admin). No tokens. Client: <fx-demo-bar slot="demo"> from shared/components/demo-bar.js (import it explicitly; renders only when window.__FNOL_DEV__===true). Session in sessionStorage "fnol.demo.session" {token,tenantId,persona}; it also mirrors the token to csr.token / adjuster.token / admin.token (+admin.who) so existing apps sign in on load with no change. Wave B: helpers in shared/personas.js: consumePersonaToken(appPath) and claimantHint() (policyNumber/lastName/zip to prefill holder check; claimant token is memory-only so the claimant app should call devLogin or consume the session token).
